self-check failed: acceptance criteria not met or not reported: "Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`: it builds the study without error and the drain source check passes on the corrected study, showing reopened returning the item to the queue."; redacted report: {"summary":"Part (2) is built. A failed source check of the explainer now queues one fix request. Part (1) was already in the base, so model.json and intro.json are unchanged. One thing is unfinished: claim c45 still cites lines 3894-3896 of bin/fm-teardown.sh. The firstmate source is not in this working copy, so I could not read the right lines, and a guessed citation would fail the source check. I did not re-cite it, and the CHANGELOG entry says so.

**What changed**
- `pin.rs`: `SourceReport.findings` holds one `SourceProblem` per contradicted, omitted or behavior statement. The checker's file name is normalized to a name in the study: a leading `page-text/` is stripped, and an unknown name becomes study-level. `problems` is built as before.
- `steward.rs`: `source_fix_request` builds the request through `StewardRequest::new` at high priority, citing each statement and its source, at most 10 per request. `open_requests` and `citing_request` find a request that is not closed and already cites a finding. The key is the line `Source finding: <path> (<kind>)`, so rewording a statement does not queue it again.
- `drain.rs`: `Check` carries the findings, and `Drain::rate` queues one request for the findings no open request cites. It does this through two new `Steps` hooks, `open_requests` and `queue_request`, both inert by default. The request goes on the queue channel, so the next wave of the same run works it.
- `tests/drain.rs`: an integration test runs the real queue through `WithRealCheck`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` has one new bullet under Unreleased > Changed.

**Already in the base (part 1)**
- model.json marks `reopened` as a `waiting` state, with t9 going from ready to reopened and t12 from reopened to queued.
- The intro lead-in and glossary say only Done ends the task. "final state" in intro.json now matches only the `done` term.
- The glossary lives in intro.json; no glossary.json exists or was created.
- A new drain test, `the_firstmate_model_returns_a_reopened_item_to_the_queue`, pins this.

**What I ran**
- `cargo run -p xtask -- site` builds the site with no error.
- The new drain tests pass: the unit tests (`source_check_fix_*`), the integration test, and `the_firstmate_model_returns_a_reopened_item_to_the_queue`.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` passes (22 tests).
- I did not run fmt, clippy or the full test suite, so I have not seen them pass.
